newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics says x2 available this month.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics says x2 available this month.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp on Monday reiterated that its x2 high-speed modem technology will be available this month.

The company said its internet service provider (ISP) customers whose networks support the x2 technology now represent more than 18 million online subscribers -- about 70 percent of the estimated 25 million subscribers worldwide.
"The x2 upgrade will be available this month," the company said in a statement, adding ISPs will be able to upgrade existing access equipment with a software upgrade.
The company said it continues to receive positive feedback from the ISPs testing the technology.
